sentences.text: Shri Mps Raghuvanshi, counsel for the applicant.

Shri Ss Dhakad, Public Prosecutor for the
respondent/ State.
Heard on the question of admission.
This revision being arguable, is admitted for final hearing.
This is first application under Section 397 of CrPC filed on behalf of the applicant for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail.

The applicant has been convicted under Section 16(1)(Ka) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo the rigorous imprisonment of one year and fine of Rs.2,000/- with default imprisonment.
It is submitted by the counsel for the applicant that the prosecution did not prove the report of Public Analyst and only the covering letter of Public Analyst was proved.

Until and unless it is proved beyond reasonable doubt that the cheese seized from the shop of the applicant was adulterated,he cannot be convicted for offence under Section 16(1)(Ka) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

It is further submitted that the applicant is in jail from the date of judgment i.e. 20 th April, 2018 and hearing of this revision is likely to take some time.
Per contra, the application is opposed by the State Counsel.
Considering the short period of sentence and the facts and circumstances of the case, this application is allowed.

On furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.40,000/-(Rupees Forty thousand only) along with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court, it is directed that the jail sentence of the applicant shall remain suspended and he be released on bail.

The applicant shall appear before the Office of this Court first on 14/10/2019 and on all other subsequent dates as may be given by the Office, for his appearance till the disposal of the prevent revision.

(G.S. Ahluwalia) Judge MKB MAHENDRA KUMAR BARIK 2018.05.04 17:19:04 +05'30'
